findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, Second Reading (vote 758; passed 66-47)
findings.note: Voted aye on second reading of HB 958, a ratified omnibus election bill. Its text includes a rule that a county board processes a voter registration application only if it affirmatively states the applicant is a US citizen, a notice and sworn-statement form for applications that leave the citizenship question blank, and a process to remove voters flagged as possible non-citizens from a federal database. Bill page: https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958

findings.motion: HB 958 Election Law Changes, M11 Concur (vote 801; passed 62-47)
findings.note: Voted aye on the House concurrence vote on the Senate changes to HB 958. The bill was presented to the Governor on 8/7/2026 and vetoed on 8/17/2026 per the ncleg bill page https://www.ncleg.gov/BillLookUp/2025/H958. Bill covers citizenship statement on registration and removal of possible non-citizens from rolls.

findings.motion: HB 834 State Board of Elections Administrative Changes, M11 Concur (vote 800; passed 74-35)
findings.note: Voted aye on concurrence for HB 834, an election administration bill. Contents were not reviewed for ID or citizenship provisions, so it is saved only as an election-law vote on the same day.
